citations.quote: Name: Yorick. Official role tags: Fighter, Tank.

core_mechanics.summary: A Fighter/Tank supported by summoned units.

citations.quote: Yorick and his summons gain bonus movement speed toward a Cursed target. Mist Walkers will leap to a nearby Cursed target and focus them.

core_mechanics.summary: Cursed targets attract faster pursuit and Mist Walker attacks.

citations.quote: Whenever Yorick uses Last Rites to score the killing blow on any enemy or damage an enemy champion or large monster, he raises a grave at their location.

core_mechanics.summary: Last Rites creates graves through kills or hits against champions and large monsters.

citations.quote: Yorick can use Awakening and Mourning Mist's mark to raise 1 Mist Walker from each grave after a 1-second delay, consuming the graves in the process.

core_mechanics.summary: Awakening and Mourning Mist convert graves into Mist Walkers.

citations.quote: Mist Walkers will autonomously advance a lane upon entering combat within.

core_mechanics.summary: Mist Walkers can continue pushing a lane.

purpose: Recognize graves as preparation for summon pressure.
title: Shepherd of Souls

citations.quote: The heal is reduced by 50% against non-champions.
Awakening counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
Yorick's next basic attack within a few seconds will gain bonus range, deal bonus physical damage, and heal him based on his missing health.
Last Rites resets Yorick's basic attack timer.

core_mechanics.summary: An empowered physical attack adds reach, healing, and an attack reset.

citations.quote: While there are at least 3 graves nearby and Last Rites is active or on cooldown, Yorick can cast Awakening.
Active: Yorick summons Mist Walkers from the graves around him.

core_mechanics.summary: Awakening is a conditional Q activation that raises nearby graves.

purpose: Recognize his empowered attack and conditional Awakening activation.
title: Last Rites and Awakening

citations.quote: Active: Yorick summons a destructible ring of spirits at the target location that knocks aside enemies hit. It remains as terrain against enemies for a few seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: A destructible terrain ring blocks enemies and knocks aside those hit.

citations.quote: Dark Procession can only be targeted by enemy champion basic attacks and turrets.

core_mechanics.summary: Enemy champion basic attacks and turrets can target the ring.

purpose: Recognize the trap and how to attack its wall.
title: Dark Procession

citations.quote: The Mist Walkers do not leap if they are immobilized or grounded, or if the marked target is untargetable.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Immobilization, grounding, or target untargetability can prevent Mist Walker leaps.

citations.quote: dealing magic damage to enemies. Enemy champions and monsters hit are also shortly slowed, and marked Cursed for a few seconds.

core_mechanics.summary: The splash damages enemies and slows and marks champions and monsters.

citations.quote: Cursed: The target is revealed and inflicted with armor reduction, and continually raises a Mist Walker from each nearby grave

core_mechanics.summary: The curse reveals, reduces armor, and raises nearby graves.

citations.quote: Yorick and his summons gain bonus movement speed toward a Cursed target. Mist Walkers will leap to a nearby Cursed target and focus them.

core_mechanics.summary: The mark directs faster pursuit and Mist Walker leaps.

purpose: Recognize the mark as the trigger for concentrated summon pressure.
title: Mourning Mist

citations.quote: Yorick's next basic attack or Mourning Mist hit against the marked target consumes the mark to deal bonus magic damage

advanced_exceptions.summary: Mourning Mist can also consume the Maiden's mark.

citations.quote: Active: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist and a few Mist Walkers at the target location. The Maiden will automatically raise Mist Walkers from dead enemies

core_mechanics.summary: The Maiden arrives with Walkers and raises more from dead enemies.

citations.quote: Touch of the Maiden: Yorick's next basic attack will consume the mark to deal bonus magic damage by a portion of the target's maximum health.

core_mechanics.summary: Her mark enables maximum-health-based bonus magic damage from Yorick's attack.

citations.quote: Recast: Yorick sets the Maiden free, allowing her to push the nearest lane.

core_mechanics.summary: The recast releases her to push a lane.

purpose: Recognize the Maiden's combat contribution and independent lane pressure.
title: Eulogy of the Isles
